jobs.occupation: Senior DevOps Engineer  Mainframe, COBOL & CI/CD - 20604
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Senior Technical Consultant to improve development tools and automated delivery pipelines within an organisation with extensive COBOL development on IBM z/OS.
The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for evaluating and improving tools, processes and technical solutions. You will work closely with developers, infrastructure teams and external technology providers to establish efficient, automated and quality-assured development and delivery processes.
What You Will Work On
Develop and maintain tools and processes for COBOL development on IBM z/OS.
Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated delivery processes.
Integrate development tools with version control and deployment solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve automation, quality and developer experience.
Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
Provide technical guidance and support to development teams.
Collaborate with internal technology teams and external suppliers.

What You Bring
Experience with COBOL development and modern mainframe development environments.
Good understanding of IBM z/OS.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD and automated development and delivery pipelines.
Experience with Git and version control.
Knowledge of Linux and Java.
Ability to take technical ownership, evaluate solutions and drive improvements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Fluency in Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Experience building modern COBOL pipelines.
Experience with z/OS development tools.
Experience with TeamCity, Artifactory or IBM DevOps Deploy.
Experience with AI-related initiatives in software development.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join a multidisciplinary development team working alongside mechanical, electronics and software engineers. The assignment involves both improving existing products and developing new mechanical designs, from initial concepts to complete manufacturing documentation.
What You Will Work On
Develop and improve mechanical product designs.
Create and maintain 3D models, technical drawings and revisions in PDM systems.
Take designs from initial concepts and requirements to manufacturing-ready documentation.
Work with tolerances, material selection and manufacturing methods.
Support prototype development, assembly and practical verification.
Independently drive mechanical design activities.
Collaborate with electronics and software engineers throughout product development.

What You Bring
A few years of experience in mechanical design and product development.
Good experience with Autodesk Inventor.
Experience managing drawings, models and revisions in PDM systems.
Ability to take designs from concept to manufacturing documentation.
Good understanding of technical drawings, tolerances, materials and manufacturing methods.
Experience with prototyping, assembly and practical verification.
Ability to independently manage design tasks.
Strong collaboration skills, particularly between mechanical and electronics disciplines.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and/or English.

Meritorious
Experience with Autodesk Vault.
Knowledge of DFAM and design for additive manufacturing.
Experience designing products for low- and medium-volume production.
Experience with 3D printing, CNC machining and sheet metal design.
Experience designing instruments, electronic products or electromechanical products.
Experience with electronic enclosures, seals and IP-rated designs.
Knowledge of DFM/DFA.
Experience with product maintenance, change management and products in serial production.
Experience with injection-moulded components.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Software Developer  C & Hardware-Near Programming - 20574
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Developer with strong skills in hardware-near programming using C.
You will work in a technically complex environment within the automotive industry, developing embedded software while considering relevant industry regulations and requirements.
Knowledge of electronics and electrical design is an advantage. The role does not involve designing circuit boards but may include technical activities related to electrical systems and production testing.

Work with topics such as signal screens, grounding, power resistors and current circuits.

Support production testing and final testing when required.

Strong experience in embedded software development using C.
Good understanding of hardware-near programming.
Experience working in technically complex environments.
Understanding of automotive industry regulations.
Good spoken and written Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Knowledge of electronics and electrical engineering.
Experience with signal screens, grounding and power resistors.
Knowledge of current circuits, braking systems and motor control.
Experience with production testing and final testing.

jobs.occupation: Operating Theatre and Anaesthesia Nurses Wanted for Falun and Mora Hospital
jobs.description:
Region Dalarna is seeking skilled Operating Theatre Nurses and Anaesthesia Nurses to join our surgical services at Falun Hospital and Mora Hospital.

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of highly competent perioperative teams delivering safe and high-quality surgical care across a broad range of specialties. You will play a key role in supporting patients before, during and after surgery while working with advanced medical technology and experienced multidisciplinary teams.

Falun Hospital is the largest hospital in Dalarna and offers a wide variety of surgical specialties, while Mora Hospital provides an important regional surgical service in a close-knit and supportive environment.
What We Offer
.Modern operating theatres and advanced clinical equipment
.Opportunities to work within diverse surgical specialties
.Continuing professional development and training
.Close collaboration with surgeons, anaesthesiologists and perioperative teams
.A 22-week intensive Swedish language programme, starting in either February or August each year. Participants receive an educational salary while studying Swedish towards C1 level, a requirement for obtaining Swedish nursing licensure. More information about our language course can be found here: 
https://youtu.be/O6JM1271MbE?si=57SiD-kuXt9iwjcq 

.A modern working environment with state-of-the-art clinical equipment
.Opportunities for continuing education and shadowing
.A minimum of 25 days of paid vacation per year
.A permanent contract, conditioned with at least 2 years of service in Region Dalarna
.Assistance for partners/spouses in finding job opportunities in Dalarna
Candidate Profile

We are looking for nurses who:
.Hold a qualification as an Operating Theatre Nurse or Anaesthesia Nurse within the EU/EEA
.Are EU/EEA citizens
.Have at least 3 years of relevant perioperative experience
.Possess English language skills at CEFR B2 level or higher
.Have strong clinical judgement and patient safety awareness
.Enjoy teamwork and interdisciplinary collaboration
.Are motivated to learn Swedish and build a long-term career in Sweden

EURES mobility supports may be available if you apply to this vacancy. Please check 
https://arbetsformedlingen.se/other-languages/english-engelska/eures-targeted-mobility-scheme-tms-sweden/for-jobseekers

jobs.occupation: Emergency Nurses Wanted for Mora Hospital, Region Dalarna, Sweden
jobs.description:
Region Dalarna is looking for experienced and motivated nurses to join the Emergency Department at Mora Hospital.

As an emergency nurse in Mora, you will work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment where no two days are the same. You will assess, prioritize and care for patients with a wide range of acute medical and surgical conditions, working closely with physicians and other healthcare professionals to provide safe and high-quality care.

Mora Hospital serves both local residents and a large number of visitors throughout the year, particularly during the tourism seasons. This creates an exciting and varied clinical setting where you will gain valuable experience in emergency care.

What We Offer
.A stimulating role in a modern emergency department
.Opportunities for professional development and specialization
.Close collaboration within multidisciplinary teams
.Structured introduction and support from experienced colleagues

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O6JM1271MbE&t=5s
.A modern working environment with state-of-the-art clinical equipment
.Opportunities for continuing education and shadowing

Candidate Profile
We are looking for registered nurses who:
.Hold EU/EEA nursing qualifications
.Are EU/EEA citizens
.Have at least 3 years of clinical experience

.Possess English language skills at CEFR B2 level or higher
.Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy teamwork
.Are committed to patient-centred care

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to join a highly technical agile development team working on advanced imaging technology in a regulated industry.
The team develops imaging solutions for radiation therapy, using real-time X-ray imaging to ensure accurate treatment targeting. The work involves advanced image reconstruction, algorithm development, machine learning, and the reconstruction of 3D images from 2D projections.
You will coordinate stakeholders, guide product priorities, and support a team of specialists developing complex software solutions.

Own and prioritize product requirements for a technically advanced software development team.
Collaborate with project management, product management, subject matter experts, and quality assurance.
Translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements and development priorities.
Support agile development and facilitate effective decision-making.
Align software development with regulatory and quality requirements.
Work closely with specialists in image reconstruction, algorithms, and machine learning.
Balance stakeholder expectations, technical feasibility, and product objectives.

What You Bring
Master’s degree in Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent field.
Extensive experience in software engineering.
Proven experience as a Product Owner.
Experience managing diverse stakeholders, including project management, product management, SMEs, and QA.
Experience working in a regulated industry.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication, collaboration, and influential leadership skills.

Meritorious
Experience in the MedTech industry.
Knowledge of machine learning.
Experience with algorithms and software for complex technical domains.
Understanding of systems engineering.
Experience in medical imaging.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager – Building Services for a major industrial transformation project supporting the transition toward fossil-free steel production in Luleå.
You will lead engineering delivery for critical building services within a large-scale industrial facility, covering HVAC, VVS, potable water, fire protection and Building Management Systems (BMS).
Key Responsibilities:
- Lead engineering activities across large-scale brownfield and greenfield CAPEX projects
- Manage HVAC, heating, ventilation, VVS, water supply, fire protection and BMS integration
- Coordinate technical interfaces and constructability reviews
- Ensure engineering deliverables meet safety, quality and regulatory requirements
- Collaborate with engineering consultants, suppliers, contractors and construction teams
- Drive technical decisions and optimize plant layouts
- Manage engineering schedules, cost forecasts and design-to-cost targets
- Ensure timely delivery of drawings, specifications and commissioning documentation
- Lead engineering teams and promote continuous improvement
Required Experience:
- 10+ years of industry experience, including 5+ years in engineering leadership
- Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Sweden
- Proven experience managing large industrial engineering projects
- Strong background in steel, pulp and paper, refinery, oil and gas, or similar industries
- Deep knowledge of HVAC, VVS, potable water, fire protection and BMS integration
- Experience with interface management, constructability and industrial plant design
- Strong engineering cost control, scheduling and stakeholder management skills
- Knowledge of Nordic engineering conditions and standards
- Fluent Swedish and English
Meritorious:
- PMP, IPMA or equivalent project management certification
- Civil engineering background within heavy industrial projects
- Experience with brownfield upgrades and industrial start-up coordination
- Knowledge of Swedish and European building services standards
- Experience with CAD/BIM, plant layouts and industrial engineering documentation
We are looking for a technically strong, hands-on engineering leader who can manage complex industrial interfaces, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and deliver safe, cost-effective engineering solutions.

Holsfjord Produkter DA is looking for an experienced and reliable tractor driver for the 2027 season.
We are a vegetable farm in Sylling, Lier, approximately 40 km west of Oslo. We grow iceberg lettuce, Chinese cabbage, cauliflower, and kale.

The job
Your main tasks will be tractor and machinery operation, including soil preparation, planting, and cultivation. 

Other duties include:
.Moving and handling irrigation equipment
.Daily checks and basic maintenance of machinery
.Transporting vegetables from the fields to cooling and storage facilities
.Loading and unloading produce and equipment
.Helping with planting, harvesting, and other physical farm work when needed

What we are looking for
.Experience operating tractors and agricultural machinery
.A valid driving licence: category T, C, or BE
.Ability to speak and understand English
.Someone who works independently, takes care of equipment, and is willing to help with different tasks

What we offer
.Seasonal employment from April to September 2027
.NOK 190-215 per hour before tax, depending on experience and qualifications
.Guaranteed 40 hours per week, with an expected average of around 45 hours depending on the season, weather, and workload
.Employment conditions in accordance with Norwegian labour laws, including overtime compensation, holiday pay, pension, and employee insurance
.Accommodation available on the farm with a private room; rental price to be confirmed
.A friendly and supportive working environment
.Opportunity to return for future seasons - we hope to find someone who will work with us for many years

How to apply
Send a short introduction and a few details about your experience to holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com. Please include which tractors and implements you have used and when you are available to work.
Please include a reference from a previous employer, if available. You are welcome to attach a CV.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

For questions, contact:
John Rasmus Swang | Farm Manager
holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you a Wiring Harness Engineer with experience from the automotive industry and a passion for developing electrical distribution systems? Then this could be your next opportunity.
ALTEN is looking for a Wiring Harness Engineer for an exciting assignment towards one of our clients within the automotive industry. In this role, you will work with the development and integration of wiring harness systems, supporting the complete development process from schematic design to 3D packaging and installation.
Your profile
We believe you have:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
3+ years of experience working with wiring harness design within the automotive industry
Experience creating and maintaining 2D wiring schematics in Saber
Experience with 3D routing, packaging, and installation design in CATIA V5 and/or Creo
Experience working with wiring harness development throughout the product development lifecycle
Understanding of vehicle electrical systems and harness integration
Experience from working in the automotive industry.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are meritorious.

About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.
Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

Job Overview
Role Summary
We are seeking a PLC / Automation Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on controller development, HMI solutions, industrial automation, and AGV implementation. The role involves developing PLC-based control systems aligned with project requirements, supporting machine integration, and contributing throughout testing, commissioning, and production start-up activities.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop PLC-based control systems in accordance with project requirements.
Develop, maintain, and improve HMI terminals and operator interfaces.
Participate in system testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project start-up activities.
Manage machine interfaces related to machine procurement and integration.
Program and implement AGV solutions within the automation environment.
Contribute to high-level system architecture, strategic planning, and system design.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and maintain clear technical documentation.
Support testing activities that may occasionally require evening or weekend work.

Technical Stack & Requirements
PLC programming and PLC-based control systems.
HMI design, development, and programming.
SCADA systems.
AGV programming and implementation.
Industrial automation and machine interfaces.
High-level architecture, strategic planning, and system design.
TCP/IP networking.
Experience with vision systems is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Several years of practical experience working with PLC solutions is required, together with experience in HMI design and programming and knowledge of SCADA systems. Candidates should have a solid understanding of TCP/IP networks and be comfortable contributing to architecture and system-design discussions. Experience with vision systems is considered advantageous. Strong English communication skills are required; Swedish language skills are beneficial.
